paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得在一次小组活动中想着自己给人的印象，却不记得其他人是否看向自己；另一次熟悉任务被看着时也较难投入。两段可分别保留，不据此比较社交能力或推断观众评价。例子不要求回看录像、找观众或重做任务，也不把场景普通当作安全证明。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls thinking about their impression during a small-group activity without remembering whether anyone was looking; another familiar task felt harder to settle into while watched. The accounts remain separate without comparing social ability or inferring an audience’s judgment. The scene requires no recording review, audience or repeated task and treats no ordinary setting as proof of safety.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得自己在意被看到时的印象；别人怎么想仍不清楚；部分场景细节想保留。”可以只读虚构卡。听者不评价表现好坏，不保证没人注意，也不要求当场展示更有信心；可以讨论想了解哪些参与方式，而不先接受障碍或外向内向标签。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names a remembered concern about being visible, leaves others’ thoughts unknown and keeps some setting details private. Read only the fictional card. A listener grades no performance, promises no absence of attention and requires no demonstration of confidence. Discussion can concern which participation options the reader wants to understand without first adopting a disorder or introversion–extroversion label.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是LSAS、SIAS、SPIN、诊断、暴露或社交训练。20条仍保留四组各五条的六类记录；计数算描述，不算事件、错误、时长、回避代价或身体症状负荷，未计分不补零。四个可重叠的主题是编辑分组，不能决定他人意图、人格、社交能力或场景安全。原观察尚无独立验证、常模或中英文测量等值；四周是编辑回忆时段，不是诊断时长或求助等待期。任何组合不解释身体感觉为无害，不要求改变联系或安全边界，也不替代合适评估和已有专业意见。四篇全文及支持说明无需作答；复制仅含公开标题与入口，不含私人类别、消息或医疗细节。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not LSAS, SIAS, SPIN, diagnosis, exposure or social training. Twenty descriptions retain four six-category records of five. Counts concern descriptions, not events, mistakes, duration, avoidance costs or physical-symptom load; unscored is not zero. Four overlapping topics are editorial groupings and determine no other person’s intent, personality, social ability or setting safety. The original observations lack independent validation, norms or established English–Chinese measurement equivalence; four weeks is an editorial recall window, not a diagnostic duration or waiting period for support. No pattern establishes that a physical sensation is harmless, requires changed contact or safety boundaries, or replaces appropriate assessment and existing professional advice. All four guides and support information need no answers. Copying contains only the public title and entry, without private categories, messages or medical details.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得想问清楚一件事，却担心开口；另一段谈话后只记得在意某句话，没有对方反应的完整资料。实际意图、回忆和未知可分开，不需要得出沟通成功或失败。例子不要求重开消息、联系对方核实或索要安心保证，也不保证真实担忧只是误会。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls wanting clarification but worrying about beginning; after another conversation they remember concern about a phrase without a complete account of the response. Intention, recollection and unknowns stay separate without a success or failure verdict. The scene requires no reopened message, confirming contact or reassurance request and offers no guarantee that a real concern was merely a misunderstanding.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡分开“本想问什么”“记得哪里费力”和“仍不知道什么”，可全用虚构内容，不填写消息。听者不测试谈话技巧，不替对方解释意图，也不要求立即发出问题；可以只讨论怎样开始专业提问。卡片不规定联系目标，支持不以成功谈话为条件。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates the intended question, remembered difficulty and remaining unknowns, using entirely fictional material without message text. A listener tests no conversation skill, explains no other person’s intent and requires no immediate question to be sent. Discussion can concern how to begin a professional question. The card sets no contact target, and support does not depend on a successful conversation.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls postponing contact with worry alongside timing and privacy considerations; for another activity they chose a less visible role without a clear reason. The accounts need no common cause and establish no unnecessary boundary or need for greater participation. The scene requires no accepted invitation, longer stay, reversed decision or demonstration of overcoming discomfort.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得计划有变化，可能有几种考虑；有些理由想保留；想了解有哪些选择。”可以只读。听者不把出席当成功或离开当失败，不替人决定参与，也不把有用支持称为依赖。讨论安排不改变既有安全边界，卡片不评估关系或场景是否安全。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card acknowledges a changed plan and several possible considerations, keeps some reasons private and asks which options are available. Reading alone is enough. A listener equates neither attendance with success nor departure with failure, makes no participation decision and labels no useful support as dependence. Discussing arrangements changes no existing safety boundary; the card assesses no relationship or setting as safe.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls an unsteady voice while speaking and concern that others noticed, without information about their reactions. The remembered sensation, concern and unknowns remain separate. Co-occurrence establishes no cause, physical safety or explanation of only anxiety. The scene assigns no voice test, mirror check, pulse measurement, altered breathing or recreated interaction.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得某种身体感觉出现在那个场景；不知道原因或别人有没有注意到；想先问哪些问题值得评估。”无需填写症状细节，可以只读虚构卡。听者不作医学保证，不要求展示感觉或等它再次出现，也不把身体担忧移交给类别判断；已有照护与合适评估不等待记录完成。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names a remembered bodily feeling in a setting, leaves its cause and others’ attention unknown and asks what questions may need assessment. Read only the fictional card without symptom details. A listener supplies no medical reassurance, requires no demonstration or recurrence and delegates no bodily concern to a category verdict. Existing care and appropriate assessment need not wait for a completed record.
